battle.name: 第二次義埃戰爭
battle.theater: 東非高原、厄立特里亞與意屬索馬里
battle.brief: 第二次義埃戰爭於1935年10月爆發，義大利以現代化的航空兵力和機械化步兵向衣索比亞的高原推進。義軍裝備的菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機於1935年正式服役，承擔轟炸與偵察任務，支援地面行動。

kit.name: 菲亞特B.R.20轟炸機
kit.history: 菲亞特B.R.20是義大利空軍在1930年代中期引進的雙發動機中型轟炸機，隸屬於轟炸航空團，主要負責對敵方縱深目標的轟炸與戰術支援。

countries: 1935年10月3日，第二次義埃戰爭在東非同時拉開兩條戰線。主要交戰國是義大利王國與埃塞俄比亞帝國。義方將本土正規軍、駐厄立特里亞與意屬索馬利亞的殖民部隊及殖民地守備軍編入東非義軍，並由皮耶特羅·巴多利奧總指揮；西線由厄立特里亞經阿斯馬拉、梅克萊指向德西，東線由意屬索馬利亞向迪雷道瓦與哈勒爾推進。埃方以海拉塞拉西一世為最高統帥，調動中央軍及阿姆哈拉、提格雷、哈勒爾等地的省軍。法屬吉布提始終不是交戰國，卻在戰局末期成為海拉塞拉西離境的出口。英國與法國雖與埃方有外交及軍事接觸，卻沒有以交戰國身分加入戰爭。
countriesEn: On 3 October 1935, the Second Italo-Ethiopian War opened along two fronts in East Africa. The principal belligerents were the Kingdom of Italy and the Ethiopian Empire. Italy combined its metropolitan regular army with colonial troops and indigenous garrison units in Eritrea and Italian Somaliland under a unified Italian East African command. Pietro Badoglio commanded this force. The western axis ran from Eritrea through Asmara and Mekele toward Dessie, while the eastern axis advanced from Italian Somaliland toward Dire Dawa and Harar. Ethiopia was led by Emperor Haile Selassie I, who mobilized the central army and provincial formations from Amhara, Tigray, Harar, and other regions. French Djibouti was never a belligerent, but it later provided the port through which Haile Selassie left the country. Britain and France maintained diplomatic and military contacts with Ethiopia but did not enter the war as belligerents.
people: 海拉塞拉西一世兼任軍隊最高統帥，既要在亞的斯亞貝巴維持中央政府，也要處理北部戰線的指揮與補給問題。他先後令最前沿據點逐步後撤，以保存中央主力，並在梅克萊、德西及後來的恩德爾塔戰區集結兵力。Dogu戰役失利後，拉斯塞尤姆（Ras Seyoum）被俘，北方軍的指揮關係隨之重組；第一次恩德爾塔戰役時，皇帝則親自到前線督率中央軍。巴多利奧掌握義軍總部，協調空軍、火砲與預備隊，並在戰局不利後更換或重新安排各軍團指揮官，卡洛·傑洛索、安東尼諾·費雷羅、喬瓦尼·博泰、皮爾齊奧·比羅利與阿戈斯蒂諾·納西等人先後擔任軍團或縱隊指揮。拉斯印魯、拉斯德斯塔與拉斯卡薩等埃塞俄比亞資深軍官也參與各階段的戰術指揮。英國軍武官菲利普·海登（Philip Haydon）在部分戰區觀察並傳回情報，但不掌握任何一方的作戰命令。
peopleEn: Emperor Haile Selassie I was both head of state and supreme commander. He had to maintain the central government in Addis Ababa while directing operations and logistics on the northern front. He ordered the foremost border positions to withdraw in stages so that central forces could be preserved, then concentrated troops around Mekele, Dessie, and later Enderta. After the defeat at Dogu, Ras Seyoum was captured and the northern command structure was reorganized. During the First Battle of Enderta, the emperor personally took charge of the central army at the front. Badoglio directed the Italian headquarters, coordinated the air force and artillery, retained a central reserve, and reassigned or replaced commanders as the situation changed. Carlo Geloso, Antonino Ferrero, Giovanni Bottai, Pirzio Biroli, and Agostino Nasi served at different times as corps or column commanders. Senior Ethiopian officers including Ras Imru, Ras Desta, and Ras Kassa also participated in operational command. The British military attaché Philip Haydon observed parts of the campaign and reported what he saw, but he held operational command in neither army.
kits: 義軍步兵主要使用6.5毫米卡爾卡諾M91步槍及同系列卡賓槍，並配備貝雷塔M1930手槍、6.5毫米布雷達M30機槍、81毫米迫擊砲與75/27型1912年野戰砲。蘭西亞L3/35履帶式小型戰車攜帶機槍，主要在公路和步兵縱隊附近提供支援；薩伏亞－馬歇蒂S.79轟炸機與SM.81轟炸及運輸機則負責偵察、對地攻擊和後方供應。義軍還有卡車、便攜式無線電電話、馬薩瓦至阿斯馬拉的鐵路，以及由港口運往內陸的前哨站。埃軍的步槍以8毫米勒貝爾M1886式與Gewehr 88式舊栓動步槍為主，並使用來源與口徑不一的舊式野戰砲及山砲。與義軍相比，埃軍車輛和野戰電話很少，後勤較依賴騾馬馱運。1935年11月以後及1936年1月，埃軍從義軍手中繳獲卡爾卡諾步槍、布雷達機槍、火砲、卡車與大量物資，暫時補上部分火力缺口，但後續仍受彈藥、備件、燃料及無線電不足限制。
kitsEn: Italian infantrymen principally carried the 6.5 mm Carcano M91 rifle and matching carbine, along with the Beretta M1930 pistol, 6.5 mm Breda M30 machine gun, 81 mm mortar, and 75/27 Mod. 1912 field gun. The Lancia L3/35 tankette carried machine guns and generally supported infantry on roads or close to column formations. Savoia-Marchetti S.79 bombers and SM.81 bomber-transport aircraft provided reconnaissance, ground attack, and logistical support. The Italian force also possessed trucks, portable field telephones and radios, the railway from Massawa to Asmara, and depots supplied through Red Sea ports. Ethiopian soldiers were mainly armed with the old bolt-action 8 mm Lebel Model 1886 and Gewehr 88 commission rifles, together with field and mountain guns of mixed types and calibres. Ethiopia had far fewer motor vehicles and field telephones than Italy and relied heavily on pack mules for inland transport. After November 1935 and during January 1936, Ethiopian forces captured Carcano rifles, Breda machine guns, artillery, trucks, and large quantities of supplies from the Italians. These weapons filled some immediate gaps, but ammunition, spare parts, fuel, and radio communications remained inadequate.
tactics: 10月3日以後，義軍以飛機偵察和攻擊邊境陣地，火砲進行射擊準備，步兵則沿少數公路推進；L3/35通常置於步兵與後方之間，並未單獨突破縱深。埃塞俄比亞邊防分隊在後方道路和補給線被切斷後逐個撤退，意軍則依次控制阿杜瓦、古拉和梅克萊。由於深入山區會拉長公路與補給，巴多利奧一面鞏固港口、鐵路和地彈庫，一面避免讓單一縱隊冒險遠征。1935年11月至冬季，埃軍利用高原地形、騎兵和步兵反擊落後的義軍分隊，奪取過往卡車、火砲和槍械，使義軍推進再度延遲。1936年1月Dogu戰役中，義軍沒有正面強攻埃軍全部正面，而從側翼切斷其退路，包圍大批埃軍。1月28日至29日的第一次恩德爾塔戰役則相反，埃軍攻入縱隊之間，迫使義軍前哨撤回並丟下裝備。巴多利奧其後停止立即正面進攻，調集砲兵、空軍情報和增援部隊，再以兩翼包圍部署實施第二次與第三次恩德爾塔戰役，於4月突破皇帝建立的高地防線。東線方面，意屬索馬利亞軍長期包圍哈勒爾，在反覆砲擊和步兵攻擊後於2月底奪取該堡壘。到2月下旬，義軍已控制德西與哈勒爾，切斷亞的斯亞貝巴通往北部的兩條主要道路。皇帝在3月至4月於Kembol與Zuqualla一帶進行的反擊未能恢復這些交通線，義軍最後集中 infantry-artillery columns 推進，5月初進入亞的斯亞貝巴。
tacticsEn: After 3 October, Italian aircraft reconnoitred and attacked border positions, artillery conducted preparatory fire, and infantry advanced along the limited road network. L3/35 tankettes normally remained between the infantry and its supply lines rather than operating as independent breakthrough forces. Ethiopian border detachments withdrew one by one after their rear roads and supply routes were cut, allowing Italy to occupy Adwa, Gura, and Mekele in succession. Because movement deep into the highlands lengthened the road and supply system, Badoglio consolidated the ports, railway, and depots and avoided committing a single column to an unsupported advance. Between November 1935 and the winter, Ethiopian infantry and cavalry struck isolated Italian detachments in the highlands, seized trucks, guns, and supplies, and delayed the renewed Italian advance. At Dogu in January 1936, the Italians avoided a direct assault against the whole Ethiopian front, turned the flanks, and cut off the Ethiopian retreat, encircling large bodies of troops. The situation reversed at the First Battle of Enderta on 28 and 29 January, when Ethiopian forces penetrated between the Italian columns, drove back the outposts, and forced the Italians to abandon equipment. Badoglio then declined another immediate frontal attack. He concentrated artillery, air reconnaissance, and reinforcements, deployed around the flanks, and conducted the Second and Third Battles of Enderta in April, breaking through the emperor's high-ground defensive system. On the eastern front, the Italian Somaliland corps surrounded and repeatedly assaulted Harar, taking the fortress late in February. By late February Italy held Dessie and Harar, severing the principal road connections between Addis Ababa and the northern forces. Ethiopian counterattacks around Kembol and Zuqualla from March into April did not restore those routes. Concentrated Italian infantry-artifact columns finally advanced into Addis Ababa in early May.
data: 戰役日期可按幾個節點固定：義軍於1935年11月5日控制古拉－阿杜瓦一線，11月8日前後占領梅克萊；Dogu戰役發生於1936年1月6日至19日；第一次恩德爾塔戰役在1月28日至29日；德西在2月25日前後、哈勒爾在2月27日前後落入義軍控制；第二次恩德爾塔戰役為4月10日至14日，第三次為4月21日至23日。義軍先頭在5月4日至5日進抵亞的斯亞貝巴，海拉塞拉西於5日離城，因此戰史常以5月5日作為首都失陷的主要日期。義大利於5月9日宣布兼并埃塞俄比亞，並於8月3日宣告主要戰事結束。兵力方面，史料通常把義方高峰投入視為五十萬量級或略高，埃方可動員的中央軍與省軍也常被概括為約五十萬；兩者都混有不同時間與不同編制，不能當作某一時刻的單線兵力。後來的義方與埃方損失數字又分別計算陣亡、受傷、失蹤、被俘及作戰地域，彼此不一致，因此這篇實錄不填入無法核實的精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: The campaign can be fixed to several dated landmarks. Italian forces controlled the Gura-Adwa line on 5 November 1935 and occupied Mekele around 8 November. The Battle of Dogu ran from 6 to 19 January 1936, and the First Battle of Enderta took place on 28 and 29 January. Italy gained control of Dessie around 25 February and Harar around 27 February. The Second Battle of Enderta was fought from 10 to 14 April, followed by the Third from 21 to 23 April. Italian leading troops reached Addis Ababa on 4 and 5 May, while Haile Selassie left the capital on 5 May, which is why 5 May is commonly used as the principal date for the city's fall. Italy proclaimed the annexation on 9 May and declared the main fighting over on 3 August. Military histories generally describe Italy's peak deployment as on the order of half a million or somewhat more. Figures for Ethiopia often combine a theoretical half-million central and provincial force. Neither total represents troops simultaneously present on a single front, because the estimates cover different dates and categories. Published Italian and Ethiopian loss totals also separate killed, wounded, missing, prisoners, and operational areas in different ways. For that reason, this account does not provide an unverified exact total for casualties.
cause: 戰爭的直接爆點是1934年12月5日瓦爾瓦爾事件。義大利主持的邊界委員會在奧加登地區遭埃塞俄比亞部隊攻擊，義方人員傷亡後，要求道歉、賠償及埃軍從爭議地區撤退。事件交由國際聯盟處理，但仲裁並未支持義大利提出的全部要求，義大利拒絕接受結果，並把事件視為埃塞俄比亞不穩定及拒絕談判的證據。更早的背景包括義大利在1920年代對經由埃塞俄比亞取得原料、开辟市場及取得勞動力的期待，以及1930年代世界經濟危機對義大利失業與殖民擴張壓力的增加。埃塞俄比亞於1927年加入國際聯盟，並一面引進外國軍事顧問和武器，一面維持對歐洲門戶開放政策；義大利決策者把這種變化視為戰略與自尊上的壓力。英法曾推動談判和仲裁，但集體強制行動遲遲未能阻止義方備戰。義大利完成厄立特里亞與意屬索馬利亞的動員後，於1935年10月3日發動入侵，並在10月7日宣布退出國際聯盟。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the Walwal incident of 5 December 1934. An Italian-led border commission in the Ogaden was attacked by Ethiopian troops. After Italian personnel were killed or wounded, Italy demanded an apology, compensation, and Ethiopian withdrawal from the disputed area. The League considered the dispute, but arbitration did not uphold all of Italy's demands. Italy rejected the outcome and presented the incident as proof that Ethiopia was unstable and unwilling to negotiate. The deeper background included Italian expectations of access to Ethiopian raw materials and markets, the supply of labor, and the pressure of unemployment and colonial expansion during the worldwide economic depression. Ethiopia had joined the League of Nations in 1927 and pursued a policy of European contact while introducing foreign advisers and weapons. Italian decision-makers treated those changes as strategic and reputational pressure. Britain and France promoted negotiation and arbitration, but collective coercion did not stop Italian preparations in time. After mobilizing Eritrea and Italian Somaliland, Italy invaded on 3 October 1935 and announced its withdrawal from the League on 7 October.
impact: 國際聯盟於1935年11月18日通過制裁，其中核心是對義大利實施軍火禁運，並表示支持埃塞俄比亞；各國沒有共同切断義大利從外部取得石油及其他原料，執行程度也不一致，因而未能迫使義軍撤退。聯盟談判席上反覆出現的技術程序辯論，使聯盟的集體安全制度受到削弱，卻沒有形成足以扭轉戰局的軍事行動。義軍在1935年12月至1936年1月的部分北方陣地使用芥末劑，埃方裝備防毒面具。義方初期否認使用，後來承認有限使用，實際規模仍有爭議。軍事上，義軍依靠飛機偵察、火砲射程、道路控制、汽車運輸和預備隊的集中部署，把理論上的兵力優勢逐步轉成戰場優勢。埃軍能以繳獲的義製武器反擊，卻缺乏穩定的備件、燃料、無線電和砲兵協調，難以長期維持機動作戰。這場勝利提升巴多利歐的軍政地位，他於1936年晉升元帥；埃塞俄比亞軍隊雖在 中央 army 崩潰後失去統一戰線，其保存的人員、經驗和裝備卻成為後續抵抗的重要基礎。
impactEn: On 18 November 1935, the League of Nations adopted sanctions against Italy. Their central measure was an arms embargo and formal support for Ethiopia, but the member states did not jointly cut Italy off from imported oil and other raw materials, and enforcement was uneven. Technical and procedural arguments within the League exposed the weakness of its collective-security system but did not generate military measures capable of reversing the invasion. Italian forces used mustard agent against some Ethiopian positions in the north between December 1935 and January 1936, and Ethiopian troops were issued respirators. Italy initially denied use and later admitted limited use; the actual scale remains disputed. Militarily, Italian reliance on aerial reconnaissance, artillery range, road control, motor transport, and centralized reserves gradually converted nominal superiority into battlefield advantage. Ethiopian troops could fight with captured Italian weapons, but shortages of spare parts, fuel, radios, and artillery coordination prevented them from sustaining mobile operations on the same scale. The victory increased Badoglio's military and political standing, and he was promoted to marshal in 1936. After Ethiopia's central field army disintegrated, its surviving personnel, experience, and equipment still provided foundations for later resistance.
result: 1936年5月5日前後，義軍占領亞的斯亞貝巴，海拉塞拉西一世前往法屬吉布提，隨即進入流亡，中央軍作為完整作戰指揮體系至此瓦解。義大利於5月9日正式宣布兼并埃塞俄比亞，把厄立特里亞、意屬索馬利亞和新占的埃塞俄比亞合併為義屬東非。8月3日，義方宣告主要戰事結束，但各地埃塞俄比亞部隊與武裝團體仍持續抵抗，使占領體系沒有立即獲得穩定控制。保存下來的埃塞俄比亞軍官與士兵，以及後續從義軍手中繳獲並奪回的卡爾卡諾步槍、火砲、卡車和通訊裝備，在抵抗運動中成為重要資源。這場戰爭對義方是明確的戰役與領土勝利，卻同時迫使義大利承擔超出本土實力的長期占領任務。1941年英國主導的東非戰役擊敗義屬東非軍，海拉塞拉西返回亞的斯亞貝巴，義大利對埃塞俄比亞的統治才真正結束。
resultEn: Around 5 May 1936, Italian forces occupied Addis Ababa. Haile Selassie I went to French Djibouti and entered exile, and the Ethiopian central army ceased to exist as a functioning field command. On 9 May, Italy formally annexed Ethiopia and combined Eritrea, Italian Somaliland, and the occupied Ethiopian territory as Italian East Africa. Italy declared the principal fighting over on 3 August, but Ethiopian regular remnants and armed local formations continued to resist, and the occupation did not immediately achieve stable control. Surviving Ethiopian officers and soldiers, together with Carcano rifles, artillery, trucks, and communications equipment preserved or later seized from Italian forces, became important resources for the resistance. The campaign was an unambiguous Italian tactical and territorial victory, but it also imposed a long occupation burden that exceeded Italy's metropolitan capacity. The British-led East African campaign of 1941 defeated Italian East African forces, Haile Selassie returned to Addis Ababa, and Italian rule in Ethiopia finally ended.
